claim: Anime's symbolic emotion vocabulary is a genuine expressive channel, not decoration - a sweatdrop does work that no facial expression can do as fast. Reach for them when a beat needs to be legible in four frames, and be aware they instantly set a comic register.
method: identical subject sentence and seed in every panel; only the option clause changes. panels marked control render the untouched subject, because SDXL cannot express absence.

panels.clause: shock lines, emphasis lines on face, shaded face

review.issue: chibi_pop ("chibi, super deformed, chibi inset") is not an emote symbol - it is anime.fx.deform_mode/sd_chibi plus mini_inset, and it will redraw the whole character while every other option in this card is a small addition, so the panel is not comparable to its neighbours. shock_lines ("shock lines, emphasis lines on face, shaded face") smuggles in "shaded face", which is the strongest tag in the clause and is exactly anime.fx.face_fault/shadowed_eyes - that panel will teach the face fault, not the shock lines.
review.fix: Delete chibi_pop; deform_mode owns it. shock_lines -> "shock lines, emphasis lines" with "shaded face" removed. Also add a "none" option with an empty clause - the card currently has no baseline to compare the symbols against.
